title: The Winster Gallop

nodes.title: The Winster Gallop
nodes.body: A galop, slowed. Two beats, the first a little heavier. Breathe where the phrase ends, not in the middle of it. Fluid: not bunched, and not a gap on every note. Still the phrase, not a click you are scored against.

source: Traditional English galop, long in the public domain. Slowed setting written for this pack. The pulse is the galop’s, heard, not a grade.
